title: Unable to activate profile after switching to dev branch
symptom: After changing from master branch to dev AAPS 3.2.0-dev-l, the user couldn't activate the profile. Clicking the ACTIVATE PROFILE button did not work, and the OVERVIEW tab still showed NO PROFILE SET. Another user reported the same bug with a confirmation dialog, and was unable to change from a copied profile.
fix: The original user was able to fix the issue by duplicating the profile and then activating the new profile with name "LocalProfile1 Copy". Another user was able to activate a profile by copying one of the standard profiles, but could not change from that profile.
evidence_quote: eventually I was able to fix the issue by duplicating the profile and then activating the new profile with name "LocalProfile1 Copy".
